column: Sample category (Sample / Negative control / Positive control)
Physical specimen identifier (e.g. bottle or tube barcode)
Environmental medium sampled (e.g. fresh water, sediment, soil)
Collection method / SOP reference (URL if available)
Collection device (e.g. Niskin bottle, grab, syringe)
Total sample amount collected (volume, mass or area)
Unit of sample amount (L, mL, g, cm2)
Sample storage temperature prior to processing (°C)
Storage solution / preservative (e.g. none, ethanol, Longmire's)
Storage duration before DNA extraction (ISO 8601, e.g. P14D)
Storage location of DNA extracts (building, freezer, rack)
Sample pre-processing performed (e.g. prefiltration, sieving, homogenisation)
Filter membrane material (e.g. PES, MCE, nylon)
Precipitation reagents used (if precipitated rather than filtered)
Amount of sample used for DNA extraction
Unit for amount used in extraction (mL, mg, g)
Cell lysis approach (e.g. bead beating, enzymatic, freeze-thaw)
DNA purification approach (column, magnetic bead, phenol-chloroform)
Extraction protocol (link to SOP or publication)
Water column depth at sampling location (m)
Negative control type (field blank / extraction blank / PCR no-template)
Raw data file name (R2, paired-end only)
Public repository accession(s) (SRA/ENA BioSample, separate with |)
Total raw read count per sample
Target sub-fragment or variable region (e.g. V4)
Sequencing technology (Illumina, ONT, PacBio, Ion Torrent)
